Risks: software bug or discrepancy discovered by independent verification; no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: A natural canonical 18-vertex highly symmetric point-line configuration admits a complete 380-subgroup fixed-space census across ten integral homotopy types and positive-dimensional degrees 1 through 4. The classification captures geometric fixed-point invariants of noncyclic subgroups, disconnected loci and topology invisible in known ordinary rational G-character tables. It is a natural exhaustive classification, not an arbitrary slice or a small routine numerical increment.
